points.description: States that the infix expression is first converted (transformed) into postfix form (postfix notation / reverse Polish notation).
points.partial_credit: Half if postfix is named as involved but the conversion step or its order (first) is not stated precisely.

points.description: States that the resulting postfix expression is then evaluated (e.g. by scanning it, typically using a stack) as the second step.
points.partial_credit: Half if evaluation is mentioned but not clearly of the postfix expression or not clearly as a second step.

points.description: Gives the correct two-stage order: conversion to postfix first, then evaluation of the postfix expression, rather than evaluating the infix expression directly.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both stages stated precisely: infix converted to postfix first, then the postfix expression evaluated. Part marks only when clearly more than half of a point is stated. Answers that only describe infix, operator precedence or stacks generally, without naming postfix conversion, earn nothing. A wrong claim (e.g. converting to prefix or evaluating infix directly) loses the affected point.
